infeasible_high_shear.message: No valid designs found. Check inputs or loosen constraints.

issues_and_repairs.issue: The first worktree-local React test could not start a Vitest worker.
issues_and_repairs.root_cause: npm 11 quarantined the pinned esbuild post-install script, leaving the ignored local dependency binary unavailable.
issues_and_repairs.resolution: Ran only the exact lockfile package's local install script inside node_modules; the same test then passed 6/6. No tracked dependency or machine-wide setting changed.

issues_and_repairs.issue: A broad targeted Mypy invocation followed FastAPI imports into unrelated existing modules and reported 36 pre-existing diagnostics.
issues_and_repairs.root_cause: Mypy expands imported modules even when three entry files are supplied; the repository's normal governed hook is the authoritative broad type lane.
issues_and_repairs.resolution: Ran configured Mypy on the changed transport-neutral optimizer owner, which passed, and reserved the normal staged hook for the complete governed type check.

issues_and_repairs.issue: A guessed session status subcommand was not supported and a packet-level session begin was rejected.
issues_and_repairs.root_cause: The maintained session CLI has no status command, and the overarching ETABS-EXCEL-BEAM-W3-CAMPAIGN start checkpoint is intentionally still active.
issues_and_repairs.resolution: Retained the campaign checkpoint, did not overwrite its timing, and used maintained context/check/end interfaces only.

issues_and_repairs.issue: The first documentation command guessed an unsupported --docs shorthand.
issues_and_repairs.root_cause: The unified checker accepts the explicit --category docs selector.
issues_and_repairs.resolution: Reran the exact maintained docs category with no reuse; all eight checks passed.

next_action: Complete docs, quick gate and normal hooks; create one immutable W3R candidate, run normal hosted review, merge only an unchanged head, then start W3E from fetched current main.
